tx: The Apex hide chaps + 3 is created by first making a unfinished apex hide draft at a pattern table, then working on it at a drafting table for 648 progress. It then turns into an unfinished apex hide chaps, which needs 1512 progress at a tailor's dummy to complete.

It may also be made by augmenting an Elite sirenic hauberk (Barrows) at an inventor's workbench.
The augmented off-hand chaotic longsword is a level 80 melee off-hand weapon created by using an augmentor on an off-hand chaotic longsword.
Aura refresh (tier 4) was a reward that could be bought from the Soul Reaper rewards shop for either 20 reaper points or 200 slayer points, or 4,000 Marks of War from War's Wares.
A baked cave potato can be found in Daemonheim, using the Dungeoneering skill.
It can be made by cooking a raw cave potato and heals the same amount, 25 life points.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 16 bane bars and a bane 2h sword + 2, requiring 4,320 progress to complete, granting a total of 11,200 Smithing experience.
The bat necklace is a reward from Treasure Hunter during the 2015 Halloween event.
It is obtained by redeeming 750 candy corn.
It could be obtained by searching the buffet table.
A big glowing lamp is a runner-up prize from opening a big Christmas present, if no other prize is won.
A blood rune obtained in the Runespan is created by siphoning blood esswraiths, blood pools (with 77 Runecrafting) and bloody skulls (with 83 Runecrafting).

It is not dropped by any specific monster.
A permanent version of this item can be obtained from Morvran by asking him about items and incentives, after completing his challenge at least once.
It is obtained by upgrading the tier 60 variant with two pieces of ensouled cloth, two spools of ensouled thread, and 20 flesh runes after the completion of Kili's Knowledge V.

sc: Huge hydra lamp is a Treasure Hunter reward, obtained from the Hydra Lamps promotion.
It, along with the regular fishing skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 99 Fishing.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Fishing skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 99 Fishing.
The Iwi outfit (orange) is a cosmetic override outfit that could be unlocked by completing parts of the tribal task list during the fifth prestige of the Tribal Trials Treasure Hunter promotion.
Kwuarm incense sticks are incense sticks that are made using the Firemaking skill that provide a stacking buff.
They are made by combining accursed acadia incense sticks with a clean kwuarm, requiring level 54 Firemaking to create and use.
Lean snail is a type of raw food that is always dropped by Bark blamish snails.
In the activities Temple Trekking/Burgh de Rott Ramble, cooked lean snail can be given to the player's follower for the trek.

Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.

sc: The plain cooking urn (empty) is an urn created by using a fire rune on a plain cooking urn (no rune).

Potatoes with butter are almost never made from scratch as it is time-consuming and the ingredients are far more expensive; their low price is due to them being dropped in large quantities by the Rorarius.
The princess blouse was previously a reward from the Kiss the Frog random event.
It can now be purchased for 2,000 coins from Iffie's Random Costume Shop in Varrock.
The promethium rapier is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.

The phylactery can give either 5, 10, 15 or 25 scraps when opened (40%, 30%, 25%, and 5% chance respectively), with an average of 10 scraps obtained from each phylactery.

sc: An unpowered necromantic seal of the Cywir is an item obtained by defeating Helwyr during Kili's Knowledge VII task whilst having at least 25 greater necroplasm in the backpack (unless a combined 10 unpowered and powered necromantic seals of the Cywir are already owned).

The walking stick is a reward from Temple Trekking after getting Rolayne Twickit to level 40.
Multiple walking sticks can be received by clicking the reward icon of Rolayne on the noticeboard.
It is unlocked by inspecting the Wallace pet, found while training Defence.
A Willow seed may be obtained from the Vinesweeper minigame for 1,800 points.
It may also be obtained by searching a bird's nest, or by looting Nature implings, and it is also a common reward from the Distractions and Diversions Evil Tree.
An XP lamp (tier 8) is an item obtained during the Broken Home quest.
It is the eighth lamp obtained in the quest, located in a chest found below the basement.
It cannot be obtained on the first playthrough and requires at least level 80 in each skill except for the skills released after Divination: Invention, Archaeology, and Necromancy.
Zarosian apron is a torso slot cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a Zarosian apron token.
